Subject: Redwood onsite workshop — hotel block and attendee preferences

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the strategy workshop with our leadership team the week of July 20. Wed like to lock a hotel room block and share attendee preferences to help with logistics. A few quick details from our side:

- Dates: Check-in Mon July 20, check-out Thu July 23 (3 nights)
- Approx attendees: 18 (8 execs, 10 staff)
- Room needs: 10 king rooms (single), 8 double-occupancy preferred where possible
- Dietary flags: 2 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free, 1 severe nut allergy
- Arrival windows: most arrive late afternoon Mon, two executives arrive Sunday evening

Budget note: our travel team has asked us to keep hotel + taxes under $280/night per room if possible. Can you confirm whether Redwood has any preferred properties or vendor rates in downtown SF? Also, can you share a preferred template for rooming lists (names, room type, arrival/departure times, airline info)?

If convenient Id like to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize the block.

Thanks,

Samantha Lee

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the note and the constraints. Were happy to handle the hotel block and rooming logistics. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood has a preferred corporate rate at Harbor Hotel (downtown) and an alternate at The Embarcadero Suites. Harbor typically can do blocks of 20+ rooms and has an executive floor.
- Ill send our rooming-list template as a spreadsheet (to include arrival times and dietary flags).
- Budget: Ill request a quote for the $250-$280 range and see where we can get concessions (breakfast credit, waived parking for execs).

Looping in Marcus (events ops) and Vivek (executive calendar) to confirm rooming constraints and whether execs prefer connecting rooms vs. separate suites. Marcus, Vivek: can you review the attendee split and advise on whether Redwood should book an additional suite for the CEOs advisor (arrives Sun) and hold any meeting rooms that morning?

Happy to do a 20-minute sync with you and Samantha tomorrow; 10:00-10:30am PT works on my end.

Aisha / Vivek —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick operational notes from my side:

1) Room block sizing: request 20 rooms (10 king single, 8 doubles, 2 suites) to give a small buffer. If Stratagem confirms 18, we can release extras 21 days prior.
2) Exec suite: agree that the CEOs advisor should have a suite (arrives Sun). We should book under Redwood master account and set up individual folios for client vs. Redwood charges.
3) Meeting space: Harbor can hold the main workshop in their 2nd-floor ballroom (capacity 60) — I recommend reserving 1 half-day on July 20 for setup (AV run-through).
4) Dietary / F&B: allow $35/head for a working breakfast, and set aside a $1200 contingency for breakout lunches with allergen-safe options.

Ive attached the draft MOU language I use for rooming and attrition terms, and the preliminary quote from Harbor (they can hold rates for 10 days once we confirm).

Attachments: Draft_MOU_Redwood-Stratagem.pdf; HarborHotel_RoomBlock_Quote.pdf
